Leah (partnerships): Heads-up: HumbleForge preview units arriving Fri. Need NDA signed, customs cleared, bench acceptance criteria, and a short feedback template. Assigning: Omar logistics, Nadia hw, Rohit bench, Sam legal.
Omar (partner-ops): I'll handle shipping + customs. Carrier ETA Fri 16:00. Need rack U and steady watt number to reserve PDUs.
Nadia (hw-eng): Units are 2x1U nodes, 1.1kW sustained per rack. Firmware tags: hf-2026-05-stable and hf-2026-05-optim. Will baseline on stable then run optim image. Need serials and checksums on arrival.
Rohit (bench): I'll own validation. Minimal tests: 4096 seq single-stream latency, batch4 throughput, 6h soak, and 300-sample quality spot check vs redwood/v1.2. Acceptance: p99 within 10% and quality delta <1%.
Sam (legal): NDA draft reviewed. I redlined telemetry and embargo terms (30 days). Sent to partner counsel; requested countersign by Wed EOD.
EventBot: Calendar event created: "HumbleForge Preview - Lab" Fri. Invitees: Leah, Omar, Nadia, Rohit, Sam.
Leah (partnerships): Rohit, can you draft a compact feedback template (perf table, infra notes, firmware list, action items)? Keep it one page.
Rohit (bench): Will do. Quick runner snippet for infra:
./bench --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --out s3://redwood-preview/humbleforge/metrics.json
I'll include fields: p50/p95/p99, token latency histogram, and go/no-go line.
Nadia (hw-eng): If we see any PCIe or driver jitter, capture dmesg, lspci, and /proc/modules. I'll reserve isolated nodes for passthrough.
Omar (partner-ops): Shipping labels and commercial invoice uploaded. Posting tracking when carrier confirms pickup.
Sam (legal): Partner asked about embargo length; they agreed to 30 days. I'll upload signed NDA when available.
Leah (partnerships): Thanks all. Action items recap: Sam - NDA by Wed; Omar - shipping + customs by Fri; Nadia - firmware + kernel capture on arrival; Rohit - bench doc + feedback template by Thu AM. Day-zero sync Thu 09:00.
Omar (partner-ops): Will post tracking + rack slot by EOD.
Leah (partnerships): Keeping this thread for coordination and day-zero notes. :rocket:
